In this case, the expression for $f(x)$ is a quotient $\frac{u(x)}{v(x)}$ with $u(x)=\operatorname{coth}⁡2x$ and $v(x)=2x.$ 

Therefore, we apply the quotient rule as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{{u}^{′}(x)\cdot v(x)-u(x)\cdot {v}^{′}(x)}{[v(x)]^{2}} \\  & =\frac{{(\operatorname{coth}⁡2x)}^{′}\cdot 2x-\operatorname{coth}⁡2x\cdot {(2x)}^{′}}{{(2x)}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{(-2{csch}^{2}⁡2x)\cdot 2x-\operatorname{coth}⁡2x\cdot (2)}{4{x}^{2}} \\  & =-\frac{2(2x{csch}^{2}⁡2x+\operatorname{coth}⁡2x)}{4{x}^{2}} \\  & =-\frac{2x{csch}^{2}⁡2x+\operatorname{coth}⁡2x}{2{x}^{2}}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
